name: Personal Finance Workbench
description: A private INR ledger for everyday use: add and edit transactions, monthly limits, recurring items, spending analysis, and CSV import and export, exact to the paisa.
author: Vakyartha

tools.name: get_ledger_context
tools.title: Read the ledger
tools.description: Read the Personal Finance Workbench ledger for one month (this month when none is given): today's date, the category names in use, money in and out, limits and what is left of them, spending by category, the latest transactions, recurring items not yet added, and the current expectedRevision. Read-only.

tools.name: add_transactions
tools.title: Add transactions
tools.description: Add 1 to 20 transactions the person described to the ledger, all or none. Give each a kind (expense or income), a positive INR amount, a short description and a category, reusing a category name from the ledger context when one fits; the date defaults to today. Read the ledger context first for the current expectedRevision. It never changes or deletes a saved transaction. Requires the person's approval.

amount.description: Positive INR amount with at most two decimals, such as 250 or 1250.50

skills.name: finance-ledger
skills.description: Add what the person spent or received to their Personal Finance Workbench ledger from a chat message, and answer questions about their month: money in and out, limits, categories and recent transactions.
